before.description: Friskoli 将细胞表面酶展示与趋化富集结合，增强菌体与固体底物的局部接触和传质，为太空生物反应器提供模块化工艺改良。纤维素用于展示这一路线，平台的作用范围由局部接触机制决定。
before.description_en: Friskoli combines cell-surface enzyme display and chemotactic enrichment to improve local cell–solid-substrate contact and mass transfer as a modular contribution to space bioreactors. Cellulose illustrates the route; the platform is centered on the contact mechanism.

narrative.zh: Friskoli 将细胞表面酶展示与趋化富集结合，增强菌体与固体底物的局部接触和传质，为太空生物反应器提供模块化工艺改良。纤维素用于展示这一路线，平台的作用范围由局部接触机制决定。
narrative.en: Friskoli combines cell-surface enzyme display and chemotactic enrichment to improve local cell–solid-substrate contact and mass transfer as a modular contribution to space bioreactors. Cellulose illustrates the route; the platform is centered on the contact mechanism.

after.description: 在纤维素示范路线中，展示于菌体表面的酶在菌体与固体底物接触处参与降解，将纤维素转化为可溶性产物，连接表面催化与后续生物利用。
after.description_en: In the cellulose demonstration route, enzymes displayed on the cell surface act at the cell–solid-substrate interface, breaking cellulose down into soluble products for subsequent biological utilization.

narrative.zh: 在纤维素示范路线中，展示于菌体表面的酶在菌体与固体底物接触处参与降解，将纤维素转化为可溶性产物，连接表面催化与后续生物利用。

after.description: 纤维素降解产生的可溶性产物从底物附近向周围扩散，形成局部浓度梯度。这些产物连接底物降解与菌体利用，浓度梯度为后续趋化富集提供方向信息。
after.description_en: Soluble products released during cellulose degradation diffuse away from the substrate, forming a local concentration gradient. These products connect substrate breakdown with cellular utilization, while the gradient provides directional information for chemotactic enrichment.

after.description: 菌体响应可溶性产物形成的趋化梯度，向底物附近富集，使携带表面酶的细胞更集中地分布在反应区域，增加菌体与固体底物接触的机会。
after.description_en: Cells respond to the chemotactic gradient generated by soluble products and accumulate near the substrate. This concentrates enzyme-displaying cells in the reaction region and increases opportunities for cell–solid-substrate contact.

after.description: 表面酶降解与趋化富集在底物附近衔接，旨在通过更充分的局部接触和传质促进生物转化。示范路线将这一过程接入菌体／代谢中间物输出，并与太空生物反应器工艺相连。
after.description_en: Surface-enzyme degradation and chemotactic enrichment act together near the substrate, aiming to support bioconversion through improved local contact and mass transfer. The demonstration route connects this process to biomass / metabolic intermediates and to space-bioreactor operations.

narrative.en: Surface-enzyme degradation and chemotactic enrichment act together near the substrate, aiming to support bioconversion through improved local contact and mass transfer. The demonstration route connects this process to biomass / metabolic intermediates and to space-bioreactor operations.

after.description: 生物塑料制造作为纤维素转化示范的候选下游，连接前段产生的菌体／代谢中间物与生物塑料产物，用于展示 Friskoli 局部传质平台与后续材料生产衔接的应用方向。
after.description_en: Bioplastic production is a candidate downstream application of the cellulose-conversion demonstration. It links upstream biomass / metabolic intermediates to bioplastic products, illustrating how the Friskoli local-mass-transfer platform could connect with subsequent material production.
